scope: An existing siege can breach walls yet fail to reduce city health. Investigate whether its matched artillery requirement and first-weapon reservation incorrectly end with the wall pool. A policy is not a strength improvement merely because it orders guns or increases military power.
development_case_selection: Previously observed losing maps from PR 4091, selected for recorded siege opportunities. Immortal 47651167238 is the primary mechanism case: Bamako has no standing walls but 200 health from turns 72 through 80 despite ready siege readings. These maps are development evidence, not fresh strength evidence.
observer_control: Before interpreting any policy change, unchanged unwrapped and traced executions must reproduce prior complete action and focal-snapshot bytes, traced journals, and semantic terminal results on all four development maps. Only explicit trace and source-provenance metadata may differ. Stop interpreting on any failed control.
candidate_observer_control: Run all four candidate development maps with and without the existing read-only observer. Complete actions and focal snapshots must match byte for byte, and terminal results must match apart from expected trace metadata.
candidate_freeze: Freeze the full candidate source manifest, source commit/tree, observer source, binary hashes, dependency locks and effective force profile before launching any fresh candidate or baseline outcome. Preserve all outcomes and commands.
fresh_seed_method: One secrets.randbelow draw without replacement from [60000000000, 70000000000), before candidate implementation or any new outcome. The first four draws are Immortal; the next four are Deity. No seed replacement, optional map selection, or outcome-dependent stopping within the cohort.

profile.focal: Gran Colombia, player 0, Domination target, handicap exempt
profile.rivals: Three adaptive CIVVIS rivals receive the registered Immortal or Deity difficulty
profile.victories: All six normal victory conditions remain enabled
profile.policy_bundle: Unchanged effective ledger plus existing forced treatment bundle used for PR 4091; no new force flags, genome changes, hidden-information access or verification changes

promotion_gate.mechanism: Demonstrate actual health reduction and captured cities, not just a new artillery ask, a ready-budget message or more military power
promotion_gate.failure: Do not promote a policy that fails this gate. Preserve the complete negative evidence and continue pursuing actual conquest victories. A failed candidate does not complete the continuous optimization goal.

secondary_evidence: Report per-map terminal outcomes, actual action contrasts, first guns, city-health trajectories, foreign-major-origin and any foreign-origin holdings, original-capital holdings, city count, production, military power, and economy. Do not present minor-city holdings as major captures or forecasts as executions.
native: Read-only calibration only. Do not restart or reconfigure the live Native game, controller, pins, genome, difficulty, force profile or victory gates. Simulation outcomes are not Native wins. A highest-difficulty win requires an actual completed Deity Domination result, not an Emperor attempt, abandonment, partial trajectory or forecast.
dependency_limit: The preserved external observer lock uses syn 3.0.3 while the repository lock uses syn 3.0.2; its CI profile differs from the repository test CI profile. Match the two experimental arms exactly and do not claim deployed-binary equivalence.
